headline: You run the league.
We build what it runs on.
hero.supporting: ScoutIQ makes websites, apps and data tools for people who run leagues, tours, clubs and small businesses.
hero.caption: A sample league. Change a score and watch the standings move.

whatWeBuild.heading: What we build
whatWeBuild.intro: Most of the people we work with already run everything from a spreadsheet. We start there.

rows.thing: A website that loads fast on a phone.
rows.detail: Schedules, results, standings, rules and sponsors, on the screen your players actually use.
Players register and pay online in a minute. The money goes straight to your account, never through ours.
Scores go in during the event. Standings update on every phone.
Profiles and results that carry over from season to season.

rows.thing: Admin tools that start from your spreadsheet.
rows.detail: Keep working in Google Sheets or Excel. Upload the file and the site updates.
Check-in, pairings and start times in one place when the day gets busy.
Rankings, ratings and forecasts, from a studio that publishes its own sports analytics.
